scope: Current London Stadium in West Ham United football mode. Scope includes the mapped bowl and roof rings, compression truss, V-column facade, lower and upper stands, field, pitch surround, roof lights and fixed concourse.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The transformation replaces the temporary roof and makes the lower bowl reconfigurable to move over the running track for football.
The contractor reports the strengthened V-columns and perimeter compression truss and a new roof of about 45,000 square metres.
The park owner reports an 84 m maximum cantilever and roof coverage over the seating in the transformed stadium.
West Ham identifies the white, blue and claret seats, triangular roof floodlights and currently configured concourse.
The Premier League handbook identifies the 105 by 68 m field.

next: Author the current roof membrane and truss around the native opening, model the lower and upper tiers around the football pitch, and preserve the original island terrain.
